findings.title: RL-SG-BALCONY fascia mounts: the modelled 5/16 x 4 in. bolts cannot reach any backing, and the authored rollover blocks sit beside and behind the bolt lines, so the fixing is washer bearing on a 1.25 in. rim / 1.5 in. edge joist

evidence.measured: Stack through the bolt (resolved model): bracket flange 0.25 + PVC fascia 1.00 + rim 1.25 (flank) or edge joist 1.50 (front) = 2.50 / 2.75 in., against a 4.00 in. bolt, leaving ~1.2 in. for washer + nut: no room to pass a 1.5 in. block sitting directly behind the rim. Front post 4: bolt shanks at x 153.61 and 158.24, y -127.25..-123.25 (tail 1.25 in. into the bay); the rollover block is at x 155.18..156.68 (sister-0-block-hi, x 155.93 +/- 0.75), i.e. 1.57 in. clear of each bolt, so no bolt touches it. Flank post 2: bolt tails stop at x 101.12; the block (sister-4-block, x 103 +/- 0.75) starts at 102.25 and the rim's inner face is 99.625, so the block is 2.6 in. off the rim. Fastener basis conflict: Ultralox 2025 Product Guide p.37 (wood substrate) says 4 x 5/16 x 6 in. structural screw SD04964, 'Ensure proper blocking', 0.50 specific gravity lumber; the repo uses the June 2024 through-bolt text (see S3-110). Order of magnitude: R301.5 200 lb at 42 in. = 8,400 lb-in; across the 4 in. bolt-row spacing the top pair sees ~2,100 lb, ~1,050 lb per bolt. An 11/16 in. washer annulus is 0.295 in2; at the engine's own wet southern-pine Fc-perp (member_grades.py:57, 565 x 0.67 = 379 psi) that is ~112 lb per bolt before any Cb credit.
evidence.expected: A fascia bracket's rollover load should reach lumber through fasteners that thread into, or bear on, backing directly behind the rim at the bolt rows (Ultralox's own 'double blocking behind', which the library string already quotes). Bolt length, stack (1 in. fascia + rim) and block position must close: either a screw/bolt long enough to seat in a block touching the rim, or backing placed on the bolt lines.
evidence.method: Probe /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/S3/p5.py and p6.py (bolt shank centres and extents from body_mesh; clusters of connected triangles), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/S3/p4.py (rim, joist and block extents from FS-SG-BALCONY.members).
